content.title: Planning a Trip to McDonald's This Easter? What to Know on Holiday Hours for 2026
content.text: Easter is here! If you're craving your favorite Mickey D's go-to, whether it be an Egg McMuffin, Quarter Pounder with Cheese or a side of fries, you may be wondering if you can get your fix this Sunday.Given that the April holiday is one of the most celebrated days of the year, many restaurants, retailers and stores are either closed or operating with adjusted hours in observance of the Christian commemoration. But what about McDonald's? Will stores be open on Easter this year?To find out, TODAY.com reached out to the fast-food chain to get the latest details, including in-store dining and drive-thrus for April 5. Whatever you've got on the calendar to mark Easter Sunday, from Easter egg hunts and family brunches to simply getting outside to enjoy a bit of spring weather, if your plans include a stop at the Golden Arches, you'll find the most up-to-date information below.Read on to find out everything you need to know about McDonald's Easter hours in 2026.If you're hoping to visit your favorite Mickey D's location this Easter, you're in luck. A majority of restaurants will be open.“Hours vary by location, but most McDonald’s in the U.S. are open on holidays,” a McDonald’s spokesperson tells TODAY.com via email. That said, McDonald’s recommends using the store locator to confirm local hours before going. To find a McDonald's near you or check hours, see the store locator right here. Restaurants Open on Easter 2026Along with McDonald's, see below for a list of restaurants that will also be open on Sunday, April 5. Arby’s: Many Arby’s locations will be open, with varying hours. Find local hours here.Benihana: A majority of Benihana restaurants will be open. Confirm local hours before going. Find local hours here. Bob Evans: Restaurants will be open on Easter. Hours may vary by location. Find local hours here. Bonchon: Restaurants will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here. Burger King: Most Burger King restaurants will be open on Easter. Customers are encouraged to confirm hours ahead of going. Find local hours here. Chili’s: Restaurants will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here. Denny’s: Restaurants will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here. Dunkin’: Many Dunkin’ locations will be open on Easter. Customers are encouraged to confirm local hours before going. Find local hours here. Krispy Kreme: Stores will be open, hours may vary by location. Find local hours here. Wendy’s: Many locations will be open on Easter. Since hours can vary by location, customers should confirm hours before going. Find local hours here.
